purpose: repeatability + thermal-drift harness (Phase 2): loop and decoy windows interleaved with cool-downs, logging power/temperature/clock, to test whether the periodicity signal is stable or tracks thermal throttling.
data: 2026-07-05-run4-repeat.csv — all samples, label column = cool / loop<n> / decoy<n>
notes: Fanless (boost fan disabled) GTX 1660 Ti. Loop clock throttled 1669->1453->1387 MHz as temp rose 51->55C, and loop periodicity fell with it (0.526->0.297->0.385), evidencing that the shape/periodicity channel is thermally driven and not a stable witness. Idle-vs-work (power level) unaffected.
